title: Delivery attempts
text: Delivery attempts. Drivers make two delivery attempts. After the second failed attempt, the parcel is held at the local depot for five calendar days.

title: Delivery delays
text: Delivery delays. A parcel delayed beyond its estimated delivery date should be checked using its tracking ID. Customers receive an updated estimate when available.

title: Damaged parcels
text: Damaged parcels. Customers should report visible parcel damage within 48 hours of delivery and provide photographs of the packaging and damaged contents.

title: Lost parcels
text: Lost parcels. A parcel with no tracking scan for seven consecutive days is eligible for a missing-parcel investigation.

title: Address correction
text: Address correction. Address changes are allowed before the parcel reaches the destination hub. Changes after dispatch may incur a redirection fee.

title: Tracking updates
text: Tracking updates. Tracking events may take up to 24 hours to appear after a physical scan. The tracking ID is required for a status enquiry.

title: Delivery proof
text: Delivery proof. Proof of delivery includes delivery timestamp and recipient confirmation. A photograph may be available for eligible doorstep deliveries.

title: Recipient unavailable
text: Recipient unavailable. If the recipient is unavailable, the driver records the attempt and may leave a delivery notice with redelivery instructions.

title: Redelivery
text: Redelivery. Customers can request one free redelivery within five days of a failed delivery attempt. Further attempts may incur a fee.

title: Parcel cancellation
text: Parcel cancellation. A shipment can be cancelled before pickup. Once collected by the carrier, cancellation requires a return-to-sender request.

title: Prohibited items
text: Prohibited items. Explosives, illegal drugs, firearms, live animals and hazardous chemicals are prohibited. Restricted goods require prior written approval.

title: Packaging standards
text: Packaging standards. Fragile items must use a rigid outer box, protective cushioning and a fragile label. The sender is responsible for suitable packaging.

title: Weight limits
text: Weight limits. Standard parcels may weigh up to 30 kilograms. Heavier shipments require freight service and advance approval.

title: Delivery coverage
text: Delivery coverage. Remote-area deliveries may require additional time. The serviceability check uses the destination postal code.

title: Refund eligibility
text: Refund eligibility. Shipping fees may be refunded when the carrier confirms a service failure attributable to the carrier. Requests must include the shipment ID.

title: Claims process
text: Claims process. Damage and loss claims require the shipment ID, purchase invoice and supporting photographs where applicable. Claims are reviewed within ten business days.

title: Cash on delivery
text: Cash on delivery. Cash-on-delivery amounts must match the amount recorded on the shipment label. Payment is collected before parcel handover.

title: International shipping
text: International shipping. International shipments require an accurate customs declaration, item description and declared value. Customs authorities may inspect or delay parcels.

title: Customer support
text: Customer support. Support requests should include the tracking ID, registered phone number and a short description of the issue.

title: Return to sender
text: Return to sender. Undeliverable parcels are returned to the sender after the five-day depot holding period unless the customer arranges redelivery.
